result: Yes, this is Shelly. The spiral shell is what I care about most, because it echoes our trail and the long, flat body feels slow and calm, which is the whole point of the walk. The spiral still looks a bit angular to me, more like straight segments than a smooth curl. The feelers look like a thin "Y" or a twig rather than gently curving outward, and with no face or eyes yet, she doesn't feel as friendly as I want for kids to spot at the start of the trail.
